readerEvidence.summary: Astra single-pass recovery. Personally visually read all 26 prepared original pages: 6 Bulgarian questions, 4 official key, 6 mixed-language final questions and 10 preliminary questions/reference pages. Preserved two whole Bulgarian problems and all original IDs; restored full printed official scoring, answers and eight original solution graphs, with native tables/appendices. No separate model checker.
sourceDiscrepancies: Official Q1 key retains preliminary Night B/C labels. Preliminary Night B table equals final/Bulgarian Night C; preliminary Night C equals final/Bulgarian Night B. The cloudy-night answer B and corresponding graph titles are preserved with an explicit edition caveat.
DataAnalysisFINAL.doc is mixed-language, with Q1 and appendices English but Q2 and its graph titles Bulgarian. It has equivalent final numerical data and tasks; Bulgarian student wording retained.
Preliminary Q2 uses seven expanded instructions and includes extraneous spectra/reference sheets. These are read for source comparison but are not imported into the final four-part Bulgarian task.
